_comment: Named markets. Filter any list with --market <name>.
counties    the property must be in one of them, matched on fips or name
cities      satisfied if the property city matches any entry
near        satisfied if the property is within radiusMiles of the point
cities and near are ORed together, because an 'area' includes the
unincorporated land around a town that a city name match would miss
waterfront  the property must be within maxDistanceFt of the waterbody
The lat and lon values below are approximate town centres. Adjust the radius
to taste: 5 miles is a reasonable reading of 'the Pegram area', and you can
widen it once you see what comes back.

markets.name: old-hickory-waterfront
markets.label: Old Hickory Lake, on the water
notes: Old Hickory Lake runs from Old Hickory Dam northeast to Cordell Hull Dam
and touches five counties, so the county list is wide and the waterfront
1000 feet is deliberate, not strict deeded frontage. The Corps of Engineers
owns a shoreline strip around most of this lake, so a large share of what
sells as lakefront is actually adjacent to Corps land with dock rights.
Testing for a parcel boundary touching the water would miss those.
Tighten to 300 feet for the truly on-the-water set, or widen to 2640 for
a half mile lake access band.
Run 'gf waterbody:fetch old-hickory-lake' before using this market.

markets.name: spring-hill
markets.label: Spring Hill area, Williamson and Maury Counties
notes: Spring Hill straddles the Williamson and Maury county line, so both
counties are listed and the radius keeps the set tight.
